---
title: "Economic Charts"
---

Charts on the U.S. economy worth watching, built from public data and updated as new data are released. Each chart comes with a short note on why it is worth watching, not a reading of what the data show. Charts that extend someone else's analysis credit and link the original.

This is a personal project, not affiliated with any employer.

## Topics

- [The AI economy](ai-economy.qmd): AI investment, adoption, and productivity.
- [Interest rates](interest-rates.qmd): the 10-year Treasury yield and the supply of long-term debt.
- [Inflation](inflation.qmd): measures of consumer price inflation.
